index.html.name: Browser calculator and scenario sharing
index.html.description: Contains styles, sliders, calculation functions, metrics, Chart.js rendering and fragment/clipboard sharing. Net savings subtracts recurring tool cost; software spend is present in both chart series. No backend routes are declared.

docker-compose.yml.name: Static nginx deployment wiring
docker-compose.yml.description: Builds the Dockerfile image, maps the host port to nginx and sets restart policy. No container was built or started.

README.md.name: Calculator overview and usage
README.md.description: Explains inputs, estimates and static-file/Docker entrypoints. The page loads Chart.js from a CDN despite its self-contained wording.
